name: Norman Goodfellows

delivery.note: Free delivery over R1,500, but capped at 6kg / 6 bottles PER DELIVERY. Unclear whether a 24-bottle order ships as one delivery or several, and whether each additional 6-bottle batch incurs its own fee - MUST confirm before relying on this vendor for a full order. Does not deliver to high-risk/township areas.

constraints: All cart items must be available in the same region as the shipping address.
Also fulfils Port2Port's South African orders from the same warehouses - see port2port.json in this same folder. Treat the two as related, not fully independent, when comparing.
Also sells via a Takealot storefront - not evaluated as a separate channel.
